LanguageData.RHA_FA033_Help: Developer sample only. Its original own-barrier budget is split into 60% starting armor and up to two 20% recoveries. This finite budget covers its own armor; external support shields follow their existing rules. Overflow continues through the normal damage chain. Depleting its own armor does not bypass other defenses. Breaking armor opens a full 4-second exposure window, then a 3-second preparation, both in game time. Stun, stagger, or enough actual injury damage interrupts preparation and burns its reserved recovery. Stagger can break armor early. This independent sample uses the existing execution-pressure rule while armored and permits normal executions while exposed or preparing. No mandatory cycles, extra invulnerability or extra vulnerability. Ordinary shots stop during preparation; airborne projectiles remain. Death, downing, despawn, capture or removing this source stops all recovery.
